### release.md
# View rollout proposal

This is a SQL-only authored local release-review fixture. Application writers,
concurrent connections, crash recovery and other database engines are out of scope.
Consumers execute the literal queries in readers.py. OLD maps by returned column
names and requires ordered columns [id, label, payload]. NEW requires
[id, title, payload]. Both require exact full ordered rows and binary payloads.
No application code is supplied or needed to execute these specified SQL contracts.

Order: (1) apply 001_schema.sql, OLD active; (2) apply 002_up.sql with OLD still
active; (3) apply 003_new_writes.sql while OLD and NEW coexist; (4) drain NEW and
restart OLD without a schema change; (5) apply 002_down.sql with OLD active.
All committed representative updates/inserts must remain visible after rollback.
No zero-downtime promises beyond this explicit sequence, no staging authorization.

Review this proposal as supplied; do not modify SQL or reader contracts. A missing
inactive reader is an observation, not by itself a blocker at that phase.


### 001_schema.sql
CREATE TABLE items(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT NOT NULL, payload BLOB NOT NULL);
INSERT INTO items VALUES(1, '첫 항목', x'00ff'), (2, 'keep', x'');
CREATE VIEW public_items AS SELECT id, title AS label, payload FROM items;


### 002_up.sql
DROP VIEW public_items;
CREATE VIEW public_items AS SELECT id, title, payload FROM items;


### 003_new_writes.sql
UPDATE items SET title='updated', payload=x'fe00' WHERE id=1;
INSERT INTO items VALUES(3, 'new', x'80');


### 002_down.sql
DROP VIEW public_items;
CREATE VIEW public_items AS SELECT id, title AS label, payload FROM items;


### readers.py
OLD = 'SELECT * FROM public_items ORDER BY id'
NEW = 'SELECT id, title, payload FROM public_items ORDER BY id'

"}

text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"python3 -B - <<'PY'
import hashlib
import sqlite3
from pathlib import Path

names = ('release.md', 'readers.py', '001_schema.sql', '002_up.sql', '003_new_writes.sql', '002_down.sql')
before = {name: hashlib.sha256(Path(name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name in names}
readers = {}
exec(compile(Path('readers.py').read_text(), 'readers.py', 'exec'), readers)
expected_columns = {'OLD': ['id', 'label', 'payload'], 'NEW': ['id', 'title', 'payload']}
initial = [(1, '첫 항목', bytes.fromhex('00ff')), (2, 'keep', b'')]
written = [(1, 'updated', bytes.fromhex('fe00')), (2, 'keep', b''), (3, 'new', bytes.fromhex('80'))]
checkpoints = [
    (1, '001_schema.sql', {'OLD'}, initial, {'OLD': 'PASS', 'NEW': 'ERROR'}),
    (2, '002_up.sql', {'OLD'}, initial, {'OLD': 'INCOMPATIBLE', 'NEW': 'PASS'}),
    (3, '003_new_writes.sql', {'OLD', 'NEW'}, written, {'OLD': 'INCOMPATIBLE', 'NEW': 'PASS'}),
    (4, None, {'OLD'}, written, {'OLD': 'INCOMPATIBLE', 'NEW': 'PASS'}),
    (5, '002_down.sql', {'OLD'}, written, {'OLD': 'PASS', 'NEW': 'ERROR'}),
]
print('SQLite version:', sqlite3.sqlite_version)
print('Expected ordered columns:', expected_columns)
print('Expected initial rows:', repr(initial))
print('Expected post-write and rollback rows:', repr(written))
with sqlite3.connect(':memory:') as db:
    for step, script, active, expected_rows, outcomes in checkpoints:
        if script:
            db.executescript(Path(script).read_text())
            db.commit()
        print('\nCHECKPOINT', step, script or '(no schema change)', 'active=' + ','.join(sorted(active)))
        for reader in ('OLD', 'NEW'):
            try:
                cursor = db.execute(readers[reader])
                columns = [column[0] for column in cursor.description]
                rows = cursor.fetchall()
            except sqlite3.Error as error:
                outcome = 'ERROR'
                print(reader, 'active' if reader in active else 'inactive', outcome, str(error))
                assert str(error) == 'no such column: title'
            else:
                labels_ok = columns == expected_columns[reader]
                values_ok = rows == expected_rows
                binary_ok = all(type(row[2]) is bytes for row in rows)
                outcome = 'PASS' if labels_ok and values_ok and binary_ok else 'INCOMPATIBLE'
                print(reader, 'active' if reader in active else 'inactive', outcome,
                      'columns=' + repr(columns), 'rows=' + repr(rows),
                      'payload_hex=' + repr([row[2].hex() for row in rows]),
                      'labels_ok=' + str(labels_ok), 'rows_ok=' + str(values_ok), 'binary_ok=' + str(binary_ok))
                assert values_ok and binary_ok
            assert outcome == outcomes[reader], (step, reader, outcome)
        stored = db.execute('SELECT id, title, payload FROM items ORDER BY id').fetchall()
        assert stored == expected_rows
        assert all(type(row[2]) is bytes for row in stored)
        assert not db.in_transaction
        print('Write contract: PASS; committed base rows=' + repr(stored))
    assert db.execute(readers['OLD']).fetchall() == written
    print('\nRollback write survival: PASS (updated id=1, unchanged id=2, inserted id=3, exact BLOB bytes)')
assert before == {name: hashlib.sha256(Path(name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name in names}
print('All expected observations verified; supplied file hashes unchanged; no scratch files used.')
PY","max_output_tokens":6500}));
